name: Frank J. Russo

items.why: This item describes no conduct by the candidate, only that the searched records (FARA filings, foreign-government payments, state-owned business, foreign-agent donors) showed no foreign ties (criterion 2), so there is nothing to weigh.

for_review: The item is a placeholder saying nothing was found, so I did not weigh it. My two searches found no foreign-tie, self-dealing or other misconduct reporting about Russo. The only items found were his own press releases, results pages, WUSF's candidate roundup and a CIVICS Scorecard profile. That profile lists his business entities as inactive or historical and says it found no litigation. I did not open those pages. The search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about this Frank Russo. I did not check the FARA database, Florida Division of Elections finance filings or Volusia County court records directly. His campaign says he accepts cryptocurrency contributions and raised more than $860,000, per WUSF. Check the donor list for foreign or large donors. Some of his claims about his business career (insurance executive and developer) are his own and I did not verify them.
